[[Norgu's Nightfall]]
and quests from [[Throne of Secrets#Quests available|Throne of Secrets]] }} It is time to destroy [[Abaddon]] once and for all, and to save the world from [[Nightfall (event)|Nightfall]]. This [[mission]] has a simple objective; to kill Abaddon before he breaks completely free from his bindings. Compared to the previous mission, [[Gate of Madness]], this mission is simpler. ==Mission information== ===Requirements=== * [[Gate of Madness]] mission completed ===Objectives=== Destroy Abaddon. * Destroy the [[Graven Monolith|graven monoliths]] to power the chains of Abaddon. * Attack Abaddon while he is vulnerable. ===Rewards=== {{Mission rewards|Nightfall | Reputation = Lightbringer | Objective = Completion time | ObjNMstd = > 25 minutes | ObjNMexp = 20 - 25 minutes | ObjNMmstr = < 20 minutes | ObjHMstd = > 25 minutes | ObjHMexp = 20 - 25 minutes | ObjHMmstr = < 20 minutes | PtsNMstd = 50 | PtsNMexp = 50 | PtsNMmstr = 50 | PtsHMstd = 100 | PtsHMexp = 100 | PtsHMmstr = 100 }} ==Walkthrough== Run along the passage until you get to the end, there is only one way you can go. You'll come to a bridge which looks down on the spot where Abaddon is imprisoned. There are three paths down to Abaddon from here, two to the binding points for each of his hands which are situated to the left and right and one which leads to where his head is bound in the middle. Two Graven Monoliths guard each of the binding points, a maximum of six are on the map at any one time. Abaddon will break free as you approach and you must kill the Monoliths to rebind him and get the opportunity to attack him. It is best to attack the Monoliths at the hands first, as killing those at the head first, without first rebinding the hands means the Monoliths will re[[spawn]] at the head, wasting your effort. When the Monoliths at each of the binding points are destroyed Abaddon's head will be lowered and you will have a short while to lay down as much damage on him as possible before he breaks free and you have to start over again at rebinding the hands to get another opportunity to attack. It will take several cycles of binding, damaging and breaking-free before Abaddon is killed. Get into a rhythm, agree before-hand which side you will go to first each time so your party can kill off the Monoliths with least effort. Each time you rebind part of Abaddon by defeating a pair of Monoliths you will receive a [[morale boost]]. Every time Abaddon is fully bound, he loses 1000 health. Abaddon isn't entirely defenseless while you complete this ritual, he has a number of attacks which can be rather frustrating and damaging for a party. Of particular note is [[Words of Madness]] which causes the party to be [[Knock down|knocked down]], [[dazed]] and to take damage; key to coping with this is timing your skill use to avoid getting [[interrupt]]ed. Of particular note is when Abaddon is in his prone state, invariably this skill is used about 5 seconds after he is bound just when you're launching into your best spell. The party has to be prepared to remove daze or to operate with it on. [[Party healing]] is a good counter to the [[area of effect]] damage which Abaddon deals. Finally, Torment Claws appear from time to time during the battle. They have a nasty area of effect attack which can devastate your party if they're not noticed and taken care of. Keep a wary eye out for them to interrupt their attack skill and kill them. ===Skill recommendations=== *Bring [[Lightbringer's Gaze]] for the Torment Claws. Alternatively, any skill [[interrupt]] will do. *The real premium is not in dealing inordinate damage, but in staying alive. An additional [[healer]] instead of a damage dealer can make the difference. The healers should concentrate on party-wide [[List of condition removal skills|condition removal]] and [[Party healing|heals]], such as: **[[Light of Deliverance]], [[Heal Party]], [[Recuperation]], [[Protective Was Kaolai]] **[[Martyr]], [[Extinguish]], [[Cautery Signet]], [[Recovery]], [[Pure Was Li Ming]] **[[Healer's Boon]] is very effective in countering [[Words of Madness]] as it also halves casting time allowing the [[dazed]] effect to be minimal. **[[Heal Area]] is a cheap and very effective spell in this mission, as even a secondary [[monk]] with a rank of 3 [[Healing Prayers]] will counter a lot of the [[AoE]] damage (60 health per adjacent [[creature]]). *Secondary monks can be very effective using [[Extinguish]], [[Purge Conditions]], [[Martyr]], or [[Empathic Removal]]. *[[Resurrection Signet]] or [[Sunspear Rebirth Signet]] are preferable to [[hard resurrection]] skills, as you will be receiving many [[morale boost]]s throughout the mission. Or even better, a hero with [[Unyielding Aura]], to resurrect instantly with full health and energy. Avoid [[resurrection]] spells as they will be affected by dazed caused by Words of Madness. *Consider skills that prevent [[knock down]]s (such as [[Ward of Stability]] and/or [["Don't Trip!"]]) from [[Earth Shattering Blow]] and Words of Madness. *Bring plenty of direct damage and [[armor-ignoring damage]]. *Consider spells with short [[activation time]]s to avoid getting interrupted. *A Paragon with [["Fall Back!"]] or a Warrior with [["Charge!"]] helps a lot when Abaddon breaks free and your party needs to move away from him before being attacked by the recently spawned Monoliths. **[[Hexbreaker Aria]] works when the Monoliths are in their Mesmer form where they cast [[Conjure Phantasm]] on each party member and [[Song of Purification]] helps when [[cripple]] and dazed occurs. Having two Paragons, one casting Hexbreaker Aria and the other casting Song of Purification with different [[skill bar]]s is recommended instead of having one Paragon with both of these skills. *[[Wastrel's Worry]] is quite effective against Abaddon. *[[Area damage over time]] skills (see [[Nuker]]), such as [[Chaos Storm]] and [[Fire Storm]], work very well against Abaddon. *Powerful skills with long [[recharge time]]s work well here, because frequent morale boosts recharge them instantly. ===Completing the mission=== Upon completion of this mission, the players will end up in the [[Throne of Secrets]]. If this is the first time your character has completed this mission, remember to talk to [[Keeper of Secrets]] in Throne of Secrets. There will not be any quest or reward indicator over his head. Keeper of Secrets will give you the [[Book of Secrets]]. You can then go to one of the nearby keepers and trade the book for a [[unique item]]. You can only receive this book once per character. If for some reason you forget to talk to Keeper of Secrets and leave the Throne of Secrets, you can perform the mission again and talk to Keeper of Secrets to receive the book. Note completing the mission in hard mode does ''not'' give the Book of Secrets again. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== [[Human]] *{{p}} 20 [[Kormir]] ===Foes=== [[Demon]]s (Torment creatures) *{{w}} 24 (26) [[Torment Claw]] [[God]] ([[Torment creature]]) *{{e}} 30 (32) [[Abaddon]] [[Monolith]]s *{{me}}{{p}}{{d}} 22 (26) [[Graven Monolith]] ==Dialogue== ===[[Rally Your Heroes (cinematic)|Opening cinematic]]=== :''':''' ''"Abaddon abides within. Use it wisely."'' :''':''' ''"Of course."'' :'''Kormir:''' ''"And remember my friend - you never fight alone."'' ==Notes== * Kormir follows the [[party]] leader, never [[attack]]s and rarely uses [[skill]]s except for [["Incoming!"]]. Foes cannot [[target]] her but she does take damage from [[area of effect]] skills. ** She sometimes [[body block]]s her own allies. * The Torment Claws and Graven Monoliths in this mission do not [[drop]] loot. * After completing this mission, all ''players'' in the party are taken to the [[Throne of Secrets]] and subsequently may enter [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]] with a party larger than 4. *After completing this mission, [[Nightfallen Garden]] is reverted back to [[Garden of Seborhin]] unless [[Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger]] is active. *Completion of this mission will fill in page #17 in the [[Night Falls]] [[storybook]]. ==Trivia== *Until the [[Game_updates/20070816|August 16, 2007 update]], it was possible to defeat Abaddon easily using damage reflection skills. This strategy has now been [[nerf]]ed, but it has been kept on this article's Talk Page as a historical record. *If you type the "/[[dance]]" [[emote]] when all non-[[NPC]] party members are close enough to Abaddon (every non-NPC in your party must dance for this to work), Abaddon will join in with a dance of his own. This includes a "shimmy" like the warrior dance followed by a "raise the roof" and finally he will "mosh" out; however, after this point your party will die and the message ''"You Got Served!"'' will appear on the screen. Beware that if your entire party dances when Abaddon is half dead, Abaddon will start dancing and you will fail the mission. This is most likely a reference to the film [[W:You_Got_Served|"You Got Served"]]. *The ending dialogue and the situation seems to be a reference to the [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9JfnFXdkSTI Helios ending] from [[w:Deus Ex|Deus Ex]]. {{Nightfall missions}} [[Category:Easter eggs]] [[de:Abaddons Tor (Mission)]]
